About this space

Just ONE house away from the sugar-white sands of 30A.

Private gated community with private beach access.

3rd-floor retreat with the master bedroom, wet bar, and private balcony with stunning Gulf views.

Luxury 5-bedroom, 5.5-bath escape, featuring a private pool, spa, indoor/outdoor fireplaces, built-in outdoor kitchen, 4 King bedrooms, a bunk room, and more!

The best of Rosemary Beach shopping, dining, and entertainment is just steps away!

The space

Welcome to “Backstage Pass”

What You’ll Love

-Exclusive Waters Edge gated community right on 30A with private beach access
-High-end coastal décor with light, breezy styling.
-Gourmet chef’s kitchen with professional appliances.
-Outdoor lounge area with fireplace, TV, summer kitchen, dining set, private pool and spa.
-Second-level living area open to kitchen with fireplace, dining space, and a wall of glass doors opening to a Gulf-facing porch.
-Third-floor private primary suite featuring a sundeck, sleeping porch, and coffee bar. Bedroom has king size bed and spa-like bathroom with soaking tub.

Inside the Home

Step through the carport and into the backyard oasis, featuring a private pool, spa, and sun loungers. Under the covered patio is an outdoor fireplace, outdoor dining area, and a built-in summer kitchen with a BBQ grill, sink, and mini fridge- perfect for outdoor meals.

Inside on the first floor, you'll find a peaceful guest suite with a King bed and an en-suite bathroom with a glass shower. There's also a half bathroom and a laundry room on this floor for your convenience.

Moving up to the second floor is the heart of the home, opening up to a bright and airy living room that features a cozy fireplace and large glass doors that lead out to the balcony (enjoy stunning Gulf views). The living room flows seamlessly into the chef's kitchen, complete with a 6-burner stove, a farmhouse sink, and island seating for four. Just past the kitchen is the dining nook with a round table for eight, a built-in wet bar/coffee maker, and a second access to the balcony.

Also on the second floor are three spacious bedrooms. The first has a King bed and en-suite bathroom with dual sinks and a glass shower. The next bedroom also has a King bed and an en-suite bathroom with glass shower. The third is a bunk room with two sets of Twin-over-Twin bunk beds, perfect for kids! This bedroom uses the dedicated bathroom across the hall, with a shower/tub combination.

All the way at the top, the entire third floor is a private retreat for the main master bedroom. It includes a King bed, a built-in morning kitchen with a coffee maker and wet bar, and a luxurious en-suite bathroom with dual sinks, a large walk-in shower, and a separate standalone soaking tub. Also enjoy your own private balcony for sunrise coffee or sunset drinks, complete with sun loungers, a balcony swing, and endless Gulf views!

Located just one house off the sand with private beach access, there's no need to worry about crowds or parking. Plus, the best of Rosemary Beach is all just a short walk away.

Location Highlights

-Nestled in a gated community on 30A with its own private boardwalk to the beach
-Next door to Rosemary Beach with boutique shopping, world-class dining, and coastal charm
-Just a 5-minute walk to Peddler’s Pavilion: a fun outdoor area with something for everyone- fashion and jewelry shops, gourmet donuts, pizza, burgers, sandwiches, and an outdoor pub and pavilion with live music most nights.


SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12 guests):

First Floor:
-Bedroom 1: King bed, en-suite bathroom with a glass shower
-Half bath
-Laundry room
-Outdoor entertainment space: private pool, spa, fireplace, lounge seating, and summer kitchen

Second Floor:
-Family room with fireplace
-Chef’s kitchen
-Dining Room with wet bar
-Bedroom 2: King bed, en-suite bathroom with dual sinks and a glass shower
-Bedroom 3: King bed, en-suite bathroom with a glass shower
-Bedroom 4: Cozy bunk room with two sets of Twin-over-Twin bunk beds
-Full bathroom with shower/tub combination

Third Floor– The Primary Retreat:
*Entire floor dedicated to a private sanctuary*
-Bedroom 5 (Master): King bed, private balcony, en-suite bathroom with dual sinks, a large walk-in shower, and a separate soaking tub
-Morning kitchen with coffee maker and wet bar
Guest access
There is parking for 3-4 cars in the driveway.

Street parking is available on a first-come, first-served basis.

Other things to note

There are 12 provided wristbands for guests to access the beach. The cost of a lost wristband is $100.00.

Pool heating must be for the full duration of your stay and must be requested 48 hours prior to check-in and paid before the heater will be turned on. Pool heating cost is $50/night of your reservation and is available October 1st - April 30th.

Beach chairs are not provided. Reach out to La Dolce Vita if you would like private beach chair set up and take down https://ldvbeach.com/beach-chairs-umbrellas

Four bikes are included with your stay! If you would like more bikes, you can rent more with La Dolce Vita https://ldvbeach.com/bikes-accessories

12 beach towels are provided.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
